jobPostingInfo.title: Clinical Pharmacology and AI/ML Fellow
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

** When applying, please upload your curriculum vitae (CV) and unofficial college transcript in PDF format under the "CV/Resume" section of the application.

Education Required:  PhD or MS    

General Description/Scope of Responsibilities:  

  • This is a one-year fellowship program in Clinical Pharmacology and Pharmacometrics, a discipline that plays a pivotal role in accelerating drug development through model-informed strategies and advanced simulation technologies. 

  • Open to pharmaceutical scientists and AI engineers eager to apply advanced analytics to drive innovation in drug development 

  • This fellow would conduct work in the field of clinical pharmacology, using various modeling and simulation tools to support drug development, including scientific machine learning pharmacodynamic models and autoencoder generative machine learning model.  This role requires critical thinking and problem-solving in a complex, cutting-edge area of drug development. 

  • The fellow will apply AI/Machine Learning or Large Language Model to work with large clinical datasets, and to participate in developing a predictive model. 

  • Develop proficiency in the use of software tools for the development of QSP, PBPK, PK/PD models and the R programming language for data management  

  • Literature review and data management: Review and capture literature source for used in the modeling. 

  • Model development, verification and validation: develop semi-mechanistic models to support drug development; apply AI/large Language Model to support the analysis and reporting in accelerated drug development. 

  • Attend Department meetings to gain exposure to drug development process 

  • Flexible start date 

  • Remote or on-site options available 

 

 

Supervisory Responsibilities:   

  • No 

Pay Rate: 75K/Year 

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness
  • Acts Inclusively
  • Demonstrates Initiative
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented
  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
  • Financial Excellence
  • Communicates with Clarity
